version_guard: Require data.json key v1_1 with subsets.main == 100 and the page text "FrontierCode 1.1". FrontierCode 1.0 (before unfair-internet-use zeroing) and the Extended subset are different identities.

scoring.metric: Score: weighted aggregate of the rubric items; solutions failing blocking criteria receive 0
scoring.notes: Reported as a percentage (methodology: "achieves a score of only 13.4%"; task authors write solutions that "target a range of scores from 0 to 100%"). Main subset: the 100 hardest of the full 150-task Extended set. Runs flagged for unfair internet use are zeroed in 1.1. Secondary benchmark, not a Composite input.

description: Whether a maintainer would merge the agent's pull request, on tasks crafted by open-source maintainers and graded with tests, rubrics and verifiers.
